mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals central bank easing, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which reduces recession risk and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth below -2,000 jobs triggers a risk-on equity reaction, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in weak-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production growth above 2% signals accelerating economic demand, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below -1% for 3 consecutive months indicates softening supply conditions, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in soft-supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 months signals disinflation, which lowers real discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a risk-on equity reaction, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tight-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
